xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: DRC 07 order dt. 29/04/2024 issued for the state of Maharashtra for the FY 2018-19. Tax demand under the order: Tax - ₹159.90 crore, Interest - ₹172.69 crore, and Penalty - ₹15.99 crore. As per last disclousre made under quarterly update, Appeal was pending before 1st Appellate Authority [Commisioner (Appeals)]
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
Order of 1st Appellate Authority[AA] issued on March 27, 2025. Major allegations raised under DRC-07 has been dropped by the AA and demand reduced to Tax - ₹ 5.69 crore, Interest ₹ 6.16 crore and Penalty ₹ 0.57 crore.
As per the above order, Tax demand survives on account of alledged adjustments in turnover in GSTR 9C; alleged Tax head mismatch (ITC); and alleged excess claim of ITC pertaining to RC cancelled suppliers & non-fillers.
The Bank is evaluating appropriate legal remedy, including filling of appeal with GSTAT, as per law.
